movie.title: King Ivory
movie.overview: Based on extensive research involving law enforcement and gang members, a never-before-seen, authentic look inside the underworld of fentanyl trafficking from gangs inside the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester a.k.a. "Big Mac."

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Inside the high-security Oklahoma State Penitentiary, incarcerated gang leaders orchestrate a sprawling and deadly illegal fentanyl trafficking operation.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Grounded in extensive real-world research with law enforcement and active gang members, this gritty crime thriller delves into the covert underworld of illicit drug distribution. From behind the walls of the Oklahoma State Penitentiary, known as 'Big Mac,' prison gang bosses maintain control over dangerous trade networks spanning across the state. The narrative exposes the intricate power dynamics between organized crime, street operations, and the specialized task forces fighting to dismantle the supply chain.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the stark backdrop of the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester, the plot centers on the covert infrastructure powering the modern fentanyl epidemic. Incarcerated gang leaders use contraband communication channels to direct street-level distribution operations, effectively turning their prison cells into command hubs for drug trafficking networks. Outside the walls, state and federal law enforcement agencies wage an uphill battle to track illicit supply routes and intercept high-potency shipments before they hit local communities. As tensions escalate between rival criminal factions vying for territory, internal betrayal threatens to blow the operation wide open. Detectives work tirelessly to link local overdoses directly back to the incarcerated kingpins, navigating a complex web of corruption and violence. The story balances multiple perspectives, contrasting the hardened resolve of narcotics agents with the calculated survival instincts of gang leaders. Ultimately, the high-stakes confrontation builds toward a crucial strike by authorities aiming to sever the penitentiary's connection to the outside world. The film delivers a relentless, authentic portrait of the human cost and institutional challenges embedded in the fight against fentanyl.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Based on comprehensive research into criminal networks and law enforcement operations, this film offers an authentic, uncompromising look inside the fentanyl supply chain. It focuses on the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester—familiarly known as 'Big Mac'—where powerful gang leaders manage complex, widespread drug distribution networks directly from maximum-security confinement. Blending elements of crime, drama, and intense thriller storytelling, the narrative examines both sides of the law, portraying the dangerous reality of narcotics trafficking alongside the exhausting efforts of law enforcement attempting to stop it.

story_structure.climax: A high-intensity confrontation peaks as law enforcement attempts to bust the central figures driving the illicit network from behind bars.
story_structure.conflict: Tensions ignite as criminal operations intersect with law enforcement efforts to track and dismantle a deadly, clandestine fentanyl supply chain.
story_structure.resolution: The dust settles to reveal the lasting impact of the operation on both institutional security and the surrounding community's fight against the crisis.
story_structure.introduction: An insider look at the Oklahoma State Penitentiary ("Big Mac") introduces the entrenched power dynamics of incarcerated gang leaders operating high-stakes drug networks.
story_structure.risingAction: Investigators face escalating resistance while delving deeper into the prison-led underworld, where trust breaks down and the risks of fentanyl distribution spike.
